description: This file declares C functions for binding GLFW window creation and control functions to Lua scripts, including window management, drawing loop control, frame rate, saving screenshots, and related global variables and callback identifiers.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a GLFW window with specified dimensions and optional rendering mode.

methods.name: noLoop
methods.description: Stops the continuous calling of the draw function, effectively pausing the rendering loop.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Allows the draw function to be called repeatedly, resuming the rendering loop.

methods.name: frameRate
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the current frame rate for rendering.

methods.name: saveWindow
methods.description: Saves the current window's contents as an image file.
